  <span class="hljs-comment">// 提取myBind的参数（除了第一个context外），用于柯里化</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bindArgs = [...<span class="hljs-variable language_">arguments</span>].<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 定义返回的绑定函数</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> boundFunction = <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 提取新函数调用时的参数</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> callArgs = [...<span class="hljs-variable language_">arguments</span>];
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 合并绑定参数和调用参数（柯里化）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> allArgs = bindArgs.<span class="hljs-title function_">concat</span>(callArgs);
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 关键：判断是否通过new调用（实例化）</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果是实例化，this应指向新创建的实例；否则指向context</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isNew = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> boundFunction;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> targetContext = isNew ? <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span> : context;
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 调用原函数并返回结果</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> self.<span class="hljs-title function_">apply</span>(targetContext, allArgs);
  };
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 保持原函数的原型链（让实例能访问原函数原型上的属性）</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (self.<span class="hljs-property"><span class="hljs-keyword">prototype</span></span>) {
    boundFunction.<span class="hljs-property"><span class="hljs-keyword">prototype</span></span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">create</span>(self.<span class="hljs-property"><span class="hljs-keyword">prototype</span></span>);
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 修复构造函数指向</span>
    boundFunction.<span class="hljs-property"><span class="hljs-keyword">prototype</span></span>.<span class="hljs-property">constructor</span> = boundFunction;
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> boundFunction;
};

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试示例</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Person</span>(<span class="hljs-params">name, age</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> = name;
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> = age;
}

<span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span>.<span class="hljs-property"><span class="hljs-keyword">prototype</span></span>.<span class="hljs-property">sayHi</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">`Hi, I'm <span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.name}</span>, <span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.age}</span> years old`</span>;
};

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试1：基础绑定</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> obj = {};
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BoundPerson</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">myBind</span>(obj, <span class="hljs-string">'Alice'</span>);
<span class="hljs-title class_">BoundPerson</span>(<span class="hljs-number">20</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(obj); <span class="hljs-comment">// { name: 'Alice', age: 20 }</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试2：柯里化传参</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BoundPerson2</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">myBind</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'Bob'</span>);
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> person2 = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BoundPerson2</span>(<span class="hljs-number">25</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(person2.<span class="hljs-title function_">sayHi</span>()); <span class="hljs-comment">// "Hi, I'm Bob, 25 years old"</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试3：实例化场景（this指向实例）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BoundPerson3</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">myBind</span>(obj);
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> person3 = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BoundPerson3</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Charlie'</span>, <span class="hljs-number">30</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(person3.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// "Charlie"（不影响obj）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(obj.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// undefined（验证实例化时this正确指向实例）</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试4：原型链继承</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(person3 <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Person</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// true（继承原函数原型）</span>

</code></pre>
<p>下面我们来分析一下这些代码</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-72">为什么要判断调用者是否为function？</h3>
<p>我们可以观察到，<strong>手写call和apply时并不需要判断是否调用者为函数，而bind却需要判断</strong>，这是为何？</p>
<p><strong>这和bind的实际理念有关</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>原生&nbsp;<code>bind</code>&nbsp;有明确的规范，非函数调用必须报错；</li>
<li><code>bind</code>&nbsp;的核心逻辑（返回绑定函数）依赖调用者是函数，否则整个逻辑无意义。</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-73">柯里化实现</h3>
<p>bind的传参是允许柯里化的，什么是柯里化？我们可以暂且理解为<strong>分段传参</strong>，就比如我们想传入一个<code>[1,2]</code>,但是允许先传一个<code>1</code>,再传一个<code>2</code>,具体的柯里化后文会详细讲解</p>
<p>这里使用了<strong>闭包</strong>实现了传参柯里化</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-74">原型链</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript">  <span class="hljs-comment">// 保持原函数的原型链（让实例能访问原函数原型上的属性）</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (self.<span class="hljs-property"><span class="hljs-keyword">prototype</span></span>) {
    boundFunction.<span class="hljs-property"><span class="hljs-keyword">prototype</span></span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">create</span>(self.<span class="hljs-property"><span class="hljs-keyword">prototype</span></span>);
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 修复构造函数指向</span>
    boundFunction.<span class="hljs-property"><span class="hljs-keyword">prototype</span></span>.<span class="hljs-property">constructor</span> = boundFunction;
  }
</code></pre>
<p>与call和apply不同的是，bind是返回一个新的函数，所以新的函数的原型链我们需要“接一下”，而且接的是原函数的原型链</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-75">为什么要判断是否通过new调用</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-kotlin" lang="kotlin"><span class="hljs-comment">// 关键：判断是否通过new调用（实例化）</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果是实例化，this应指向新创建的实例；否则指向context</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isNew = <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span> instanceof boundFunction;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> targetContext = isNew ? <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span> : context;
</code></pre>
<p>判断是否通过&nbsp;<code>new</code>&nbsp;调用（即是否作为构造函数实例化），是为了<strong>兼容原生&nbsp;<code>bind</code>&nbsp;方法的核心特性 —— 当绑定函数被当作构造函数使用时，<code>this</code>&nbsp;应指向新创建的实例，而非&nbsp;<code>bind</code>&nbsp;时指定的&nbsp;<code>context</code></strong>。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-76">九、实现AJAX请求</h2>
<p>我们这里以实现get请求为例，其他的请求方式类似</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 创建XMLHttpRequest对象</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">var</span> xhr = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">XMLHttpRequest</span>();

<span class="hljs-comment">// 配置请求：请求方式、URL、是否异步</span>
xhr.<span class="hljs-title function_">open</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'GET'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'https://api.example.com/data'</span>, <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 设置请求头（可选，根据需要添加）</span>
xhr.<span class="hljs-title function_">setRequestHeader</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Content-Type'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'application/json'</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 定义请求完成后的回调函数</span>
xhr.<span class="hljs-property">onload</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 请求成功（状态码200-299）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (xhr.<span class="hljs-property">status</span> &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">200</span> &amp;&amp; xhr.<span class="hljs-property">status</span> &lt; <span class="hljs-number">300</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 解析响应数据</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">var</span> responseData = <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">parse</span>(xhr.<span class="hljs-property">responseText</span>);
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'请求成功:'</span>, responseData);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 请求失败</span>
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'请求失败，状态码:'</span>, xhr.<span class="hljs-property">status</span>);
    }
};

<span class="hljs-comment">// 网络错误时的处理</span>
xhr.<span class="hljs-property">onerror</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'网络错误'</span>);
};

<span class="hljs-comment">// 发送请求</span>
xhr.<span class="hljs-title function_">send</span>();
</code></pre>
<p>怎么说呢，我将其总结为<strong>四部分</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>配置部分</li>
<li>处理回调部分</li>
<li>处理网络错误部分</li>
<li>发送请求部分</li>
</ul>
<p>大家可以自己去代码中找一找这几部分，加深理解</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-77">十、实现深拷贝</h2>
<p><strong>深拷贝</strong>是指创建一个新的对象，<strong>完全复制原对象的所有属性和嵌套对象，新旧对象之间完全独立，修改其中一个不会影响另一个</strong>。<br>
<strong>浅拷贝</strong>指的是将一个对象的属性值复制到另一个对象，<strong>如果有的属性的值为引用类型的话，那么会将这个引用的地址复制给对象</strong>，因此两个对象会<strong>有同一个引用类型的引用</strong>。</p>
<p>这里我们来<strong>实现深拷贝</strong></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-78">预备知识</h3>
<p>这里我们还是需要一些前置的知识的</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-79">WeakMap</h3>
<p><strong>WeakMap</strong> 是 JavaScript 中的一种<strong>特殊集合类型，主要用于存储键值对，但其特性与普通的 Map 有显著区别</strong>，尤其在<strong>内存管理方面有独特优势</strong>。</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>键必须是对象类型</strong><br>
WeakMap 的键<strong>只能是对象</strong>（或继承自 Object 的类型，如数组、函数等），不能是基本类型（number、string、boolean 等）。如果使用基本类型作为键，会直接报错。
const wm = new WeakMap();
wm.set({}, 'value'); // 有效
wm.set(123, 'value'); // 报错：TypeError: Invalid value used as weak map key</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>弱引用特性（核心）</strong><br>
WeakMap 对键的<strong>引用是「弱引用」</strong>，这意味着：当键对象没有其他强引用时，<strong>垃圾回收机制</strong>（GC）会自动回收该对象的内存，同时 WeakMap 中<strong>对应的键值对也会被自动移除，不会阻碍垃圾回收</strong>。</p>
<p>对比普通 Map：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini">// 普通 Map（强引用）
const <span class="hljs-attr">map</span> = new Map()<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
let <span class="hljs-attr">obj</span> = { name: <span class="hljs-string">'test'</span> }<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
map.set(obj, 'value')<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
<span class="hljs-attr">obj</span> = null<span class="hljs-comment">; // 虽然obj被置空，但Map仍保留对原对象的强引用，原对象不会被GC回收</span>

// WeakMap（弱引用）
const <span class="hljs-attr">wm</span> = new WeakMap()<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
let <span class="hljs-attr">obj2</span> = { name: <span class="hljs-string">'test'</span> }<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
wm.set(obj2, 'value')<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
<span class="hljs-attr">obj2</span> = null<span class="hljs-comment">; // obj2的强引用消失，原对象会被GC回收，wm中对应的键值对也会被移除</span>
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>不可遍历性</strong><br>
WeakMap 没有&nbsp;<code>keys()</code>、<code>values()</code>、<code>entries()</code>&nbsp;等遍历方法，也没有&nbsp;<code>size</code>&nbsp;属性，无法获取其中的键值对数量或遍历所有内容。这是<strong>因为键可能随时被 GC 回收，遍历操作没有稳定的结果</strong>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>常用方法</strong><br>
仅支持四种基本操作：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>wm.set(key, value)</code>：添加键值对（返回 WeakMap 实例）</li>
<li><code>wm.get(key)</code>：根据键获取值（键不存在则返回 undefined）</li>
<li><code>wm.has(key)</code>：判断是否存在指定键（返回 boolean）</li>
<li><code>wm.delete(key)</code>：删除指定键值对（返回 boolean，表示是否删除成功）</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 data-id="heading-80">Reflect.ownKeys(obj)</h3>
<p>这是一个<strong>获取对象所有自有属性（不包括继承的属性）的方法</strong></p>
<p><strong>返回值是一个包含所有属性键的数组</strong>，包括：</p>
<ul>
<li>可枚举属性</li>
<li>不可枚举属性</li>
<li>ymbol 类型的属性</li>
</ul>
<p>相当于&nbsp;<code>Object.getOwnPropertyNames(obj).concat(Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(obj))</code>&nbsp;的更简洁写法</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-81">手写代码实现</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">deepClone</span>(<span class="hljs-params">obj, hash = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">WeakMap</span>()</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理null和基本数据类型</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (obj === <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> || <span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> obj !== <span class="hljs-string">'object'</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> obj;
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理循环引用</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (hash.<span class="hljs-title function_">has</span>(obj)) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> hash.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(obj);
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> cloneObj;
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理日期对象</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (obj <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>) {
    cloneObj = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>();
    cloneObj.<span class="hljs-title function_">setTime</span>(obj.<span class="hljs-title function_">getTime</span>());
    hash.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(obj, cloneObj);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> cloneObj;
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理正则对象</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (obj <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RegExp</span>) {
    cloneObj = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RegExp</span>(obj.<span class="hljs-property">source</span>, obj.<span class="hljs-property">flags</span>);
    hash.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(obj, cloneObj);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> cloneObj;
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理数组和对象</span>
  cloneObj = <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">isArray</span>(obj) ? [] : {};
  hash.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(obj, cloneObj);
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 递归拷贝属性</span>
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Reflect</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">ownKeys</span>(obj).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">key</span> =&gt;</span> {
    cloneObj[key] = <span class="hljs-title function_">deepClone</span>(obj[key], hash);
  });
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> cloneObj;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试用例</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> obj = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">a</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">b</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'hello'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">c</span>: [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>],
  <span class="hljs-attr">d</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: <span class="hljs-number">10</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-number">20</span> },
  <span class="hljs-attr">e</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>(),
  <span class="hljs-attr">f</span>: <span class="hljs-regexp">/abc/g</span>,
};
obj.<span class="hljs-property">self</span> = obj; <span class="hljs-comment">// 循环引用</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> clonedObj = <span class="hljs-title function_">deepClone</span>(obj);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(clonedObj);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(clonedObj !== obj); <span class="hljs-comment">// true</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(clonedObj.<span class="hljs-property">c</span> !== obj.<span class="hljs-property">c</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// true</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(clonedObj.<span class="hljs-property">d</span> !== obj.<span class="hljs-property">d</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// true</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(clonedObj.<span class="hljs-property">self</span> === clonedObj); <span class="hljs-comment">// true，正确处理循环引用</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>这里对代码的逻辑进行一些讲解</strong></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-82"><strong>首先是对特殊情况的处理</strong></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-csharp" lang="csharp"><span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (obj === <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> || <span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> obj !== <span class="hljs-string">'object'</span>) { 
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> obj; 
}
</code></pre>
<p>对于null和基本数据类型，我们可以直接返回，因为这些并不是引用属性</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-83">怎么就return了</h4>
<p>我们可以看到我们的深拷贝方法有很多的return，这是为何，这不会导致方法提前结束吗？</p>
<p>对于处理日期对象和正则对象，我们单独进行了return，这里是处理整个对象，而不是一个对象中的某个方法(对象)，相反，这里的return是为了之后的递归做准备</p>
<p>认真看一下我们下面的代码</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini">Reflect.ownKeys(obj).forEach(<span class="hljs-attr">key</span> =&gt; { 
    cloneObj<span class="hljs-section">[key]</span> = deepClone(obj<span class="hljs-section">[key]</span>, hash)<span class="hljs-comment">; </span>
})<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
</code></pre>
<p>这里我们对待拷贝对象的每一个属性进行了递归调用，正确处理了待拷贝对象的每一个属性(包括对象属性)</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-84">如何避免的循环引用</h4>
<p><strong>什么是循环引用</strong></p>
<p>这里举一个最简单的循环引用的例子</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini">onst <span class="hljs-attr">obj</span> = { name: <span class="hljs-string">"测试"</span> }<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
<span class="hljs-attr">obj.self</span> = obj<span class="hljs-comment">; // obj的self属性引用obj自己</span>
// 结构示意：obj → self → obj → self → ...（无限循环）
</code></pre>
<p>我们来看一下对这部分的循环引用，<strong>我们要拷贝obj.self，我们发现其值是obj，那么我们递归去拷贝obj，我们发现拷贝obj时又碰到了obj.self，于是我们又要去拷贝obj...</strong></p>
<p>那么我们在手写深拷贝时如何去规避这个循环引用问题呢？</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-kotlin" lang="kotlin"><span class="hljs-comment">// 处理循环引用 </span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (hash.has(obj)) { 
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> hash.<span class="hljs-keyword">get</span>(obj); 
}
</code></pre>
<p>规避循环引用的核心机制是通过&nbsp;<strong><code>WeakMap</code>&nbsp;记录已拷贝的对象</strong>，当<strong>检测到重复引用时直接返回已拷贝的版本，从而避免无限递归</strong>。</p>
<p>再用我们之前的例子来推一遍</p>
<p>我们要拷贝obj.self，我们发现其值是obj，那么hash里面有没有obj呢？有的，在我们第一次进入深拷贝时就已经有了</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-python" lang="python"><span class="hljs-built_in">hash</span>.<span class="hljs-built_in">set</span>(obj, cloneObj);
</code></pre>
<p>那么就会直接用之前拷贝过的obj，从而避免了循环引用</p>
<p>当然，我们也可以给面试官讲一些其他的深拷贝知识，展示一下自己的知识面之广，比如</p>
<p><strong>函数库lodash的_.cloneDeep方法</strong></p>
<p>这个方法可以直接进行深拷贝，使用方式如下</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini"><span class="hljs-attr">obj1</span>={
.....
}
<span class="hljs-attr">obj2</span>=_.cloneDeep(obj1)
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-85">十一、实现数组的乱序输出</h2>
<p>实现数组的乱序输出的意思，就是实现数组的乱序输出，确实没啥好讲的</p>
<p>实现乱序输出主要有两种方法，可以给面试官介绍这两种方法，然后我们可以给面试官推荐一下使用哪一个</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-86">前置知识</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-87">Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1))</h4>
<p>1.&nbsp;<code>Math.random()</code></p>
<ul>
<li>功能：生成一个&nbsp;[0, 1) 区间的伪随机浮点数（包含 0，不包含 1）</li>
</ul>
<p>2.&nbsp;<code>Math.random() * (i + 1)</code></p>
<ul>
<li>功能：将随机数范围缩放至&nbsp; <strong>[0, i + 1)</strong></li>
<li>原理：乘法缩放。假设&nbsp;<code>i = 5</code>，则&nbsp;<code>i + 1 = 6</code>，结果范围是&nbsp;<code>[0, 6)</code></li>
</ul>
<p>3.&nbsp;<code>Math.floor(...)</code></p>
<ul>
<li>功能：对结果向下取整，得到&nbsp; <strong>[0, i] 区间的整数</strong>（包含 0 和 i）</li>
<li>原理：<code>Math.floor</code>&nbsp;会去掉小数部分，只保留整数部分</li>
</ul>
<p>当&nbsp;<code>i</code>&nbsp;是一个整数时，<code>Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1))</code>&nbsp;会<strong>随机生成一个 0 到 i 之间（包含 0 和 i）的整数</strong>，且每个整数被选中的概率均等。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-88">sort方法</h4>
<p>你可能是想了解 JavaScript 中的&nbsp;<strong><code>sort()</code>&nbsp;方法</strong>（推测是拼写误差）。<code>sort()</code>&nbsp;是数组对象的一个核心方法，用于对数组元素进行排序，并返回排序后的数组（会修改原数组）。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-89">一、基本用法</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini">const <span class="hljs-attr">arr</span> = [<span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">4</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>]<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
arr.sort()<span class="hljs-comment">; </span>
console.log(arr)<span class="hljs-comment">; // [1, 2, 3, 4]（默认升序）</span>
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>返回值</strong>：排序后的原数组（注意：不是新数组，会直接修改原数组）。</li>
<li><strong>默认排序规则</strong>：将元素转换为字符串后，按照 Unicode 编码顺序排序。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-90">二、自定义排序（核心）</h4>
<p><code>sort()</code>&nbsp;可以接收一个<strong>比较函数（callback）</strong> ，用于自定义排序逻辑。比较函数的返回值决定了元素的排序顺序：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">function compare(<span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span>, <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span>) {
  // <span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span> 和 <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span> 是数组中相邻的两个元素
  if (<span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span> &lt; <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span>) return -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>; // <span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span> 排在 <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span> 前面
  if (<span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span>) return <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;  // <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span> 排在 <span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span> 前面
  return <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;             // <span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span> 和 <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span> 位置不变
}

const arr = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[3, 1, 4, 2]</span>;
arr<span class="hljs-selector-class">.sort</span>(compare); 
console<span class="hljs-selector-class">.log</span>(arr); // <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[1, 2, 3, 4]</span>（升序）
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-91">简化写法（我们代码中使用的）：</h4>
<ul>
<li>升序：<code>arr.sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b)</code></li>
<li>降序：<code>arr.sort((a, b) =&gt; b - a)</code></li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-92">三、注意事项</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>原数组被修改</strong><br>
<code>sort()</code>&nbsp;是 “原地排序”，会直接改变原数组。如果需要保留原数组，需先复制：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">const arr = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[3, 1, 4, 2]</span>;
const sortedArr = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[...arr]</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.sort</span>((<span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span>, <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span> - <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span>); // 复制后排序，不影响原数组
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>默认排序的坑</strong><br>
默认按字符串编码排序，可能导致数字排序异常：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">const arr = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[10, 2, 100]</span>;
arr<span class="hljs-selector-class">.sort</span>(); // 结果：<span class="hljs-selector-attr">[10, 100, 2]</span>（因为 "<span class="hljs-number">10</span>" 的首字符 "<span class="hljs-number">1</span>" 在 "<span class="hljs-number">2</span>" 之前）
// 正确做法：用比较函数
arr<span class="hljs-selector-class">.sort</span>((<span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span>, <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span> - <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span>); // <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[2, 10, 100]</span>
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>复杂对象排序</strong><br>
可通过比较函数对对象的某个属性排序：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">const users = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[  { name: <span class="hljs-string">'Bob'</span>, age: 25 },  { name: <span class="hljs-string">'Alice'</span>, age: 20 }]</span>;
// 按 age 升序
users<span class="hljs-selector-class">.sort</span>((<span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span>, <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-selector-tag">a</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.age</span> - <span class="hljs-selector-tag">b</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.age</span>); 
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 data-id="heading-93">手写实现</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss"><span class="hljs-comment">// 方法1: Fisher-Yates 洗牌算法（推荐）</span>
function <span class="hljs-built_in">shuffleArray</span>(arr) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 先复制原数组，避免修改原数组</span>
  const newArr = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[...arr]</span>;
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 从数组末尾开始遍历</span>
  for (let i = newArr.length - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; i &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i--) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 生成一个0到i之间的随机索引</span>
    const j = Math<span class="hljs-selector-class">.floor</span>(Math.random() * (i + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>));
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 交换第i个和第j个元素</span>
    <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[newArr[i]</span>, newArr<span class="hljs-selector-attr">[j]</span>] = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[newArr[j]</span>, newArr<span class="hljs-selector-attr">[i]</span>];
  }
  
  return newArr;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 方法2: 使用sort方法（不推荐，随机性不均匀）</span>
function <span class="hljs-built_in">shuffleWithSort</span>(arr) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 复制原数组</span>
  const newArr = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[...arr]</span>;
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 使用sort和随机数进行排序</span>
  newArr<span class="hljs-selector-class">.sort</span>(() =&gt; Math<span class="hljs-selector-class">.random</span>() - <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>);
  
  return newArr;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试</span>
const original = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]</span>;
console<span class="hljs-selector-class">.log</span>("原数组:", original);
console<span class="hljs-selector-class">.log</span>("Fisher-Yates洗牌结果:", shuffleArray(original));
console<span class="hljs-selector-class">.log</span>("sort方法洗牌结果:", shuffleWithSort(original));

<span class="hljs-comment">// 验证Fisher-Yates算法的均匀性（大量测试）</span>
function <span class="hljs-built_in">testShuffleUniformity</span>() {
  const arr = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[0, 1, 2]</span>;
  const counts = Array<span class="hljs-selector-class">.from</span>({length: <span class="hljs-number">3</span>}, () =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">Array</span>(<span class="hljs-number">3</span>)<span class="hljs-selector-class">.fill</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>));
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 测试100万次</span>
  for (let i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; <span class="hljs-number">1000000</span>; i++) {
    const shuffled = <span class="hljs-built_in">shuffleArray</span>(arr);
    shuffled<span class="hljs-selector-class">.forEach</span>((val, idx) =&gt; counts<span class="hljs-selector-attr">[val]</span><span class="hljs-selector-attr">[idx]</span>++);
  }
  
  console<span class="hljs-selector-class">.log</span>("各元素在各位置出现的次数（应大致相等）:");
  console<span class="hljs-selector-class">.log</span>(counts);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 运行均匀性测试</span>
<span class="hljs-built_in">testShuffleUniformity</span>();
</code></pre>
<p><strong>其实代码很容易看懂，但是我们来讨论一个问题，为什么shot方法会导致随机性不均匀？</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong><code>sort()</code>&nbsp;的比较次数是固定的，且与数组长度相关</strong><br>
对于长度为&nbsp;<code>n</code>&nbsp;的数组，<code>sort()</code>&nbsp;会进行固定次数的元素比较（例如，V8 中对短数组用插入排序，比较次数约为&nbsp;<code>n²</code>&nbsp;级别）。每次比较时，随机返回&nbsp;<code>-1</code>&nbsp;或&nbsp;<code>1</code>（通过&nbsp;<code>Math.random() - 0.5</code>&nbsp;实现，50% 概率返回正数，50% 负数），但<strong>固定的比较次数无法覆盖所有可能的排列组合</strong>，导致某些元素的位置被 “偏爱”。</p>
<p>举个例子：<br>
对于&nbsp;<code>[a, b, c]</code>，<code>sort()</code>&nbsp;会进行 3 次比较（假设内部用插入排序）：</p>
<ul>
<li>比较&nbsp;<code>b</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>a</code></li>
<li>比较&nbsp;<code>c</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>b</code></li>
<li>比较&nbsp;<code>c</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>a</code>（可能）<br>
这 3 次随机比较的结果，无法让 6 种可能的排列（3! = 6）以均等概率出现。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<p>我将其总结为固定的比较次数和概率相等之间的矛盾</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>比较函数的 “传递性” 被破坏</strong><br>
正常的排序比较函数需要满足<strong>传递性</strong>（例如，若&nbsp;<code>a &gt; b</code>&nbsp;且&nbsp;<code>b &gt; c</code>，则&nbsp;<code>a &gt; c</code>），但随机返回的比较结果（<code>-1</code>&nbsp;或&nbsp;<code>1</code>）会打破这种传递性。<br>
<code>sort()</code>&nbsp;内部算法依赖传递性来优化排序过程，当传递性被破坏时，排序的稳定性会下降，最终导致元素位置的概率分布不均匀。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>不同引擎的实现差异加剧了不均匀性</strong><br>
不同 JavaScript 引擎（如 V8、SpiderMonkey）的&nbsp;<code>sort()</code>&nbsp;实现不同（例如，短数组用插入排序，长数组用快速排序或 Timsort），比较次数和比较顺序会不同，但无论哪种实现，都无法通过随机比较函数得到均匀的概率分布。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 data-id="heading-94">十二、实现数组的扁平化</h2>
<p><strong>数组扁平化是指将一个多维数组转换为一维数组的过程</strong>。例如将 [1, [2, [3, 4], 5]] 转换为 [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]。</p>
<p>当我们对一个问题的解法有多种的时候，我们就可以进行一些深入的交流</p>
<p>“您是否需要版本控制？”“您想让我使用什么技术实现？reduce怎么样？”</p>
<p>看着是不是很<strong>专业</strong>，对吧，面试就是要这种效果。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-95">前置知识</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-96">reduce</h4>
<p><code>reduce()</code>&nbsp;是数组的高阶函数，用于将数组元素通过回调函数 “累积” 为单个值，语法为&nbsp;<code>arr.reduce(callback, initialValue)</code>。</p>
<p>核心逻辑：</p>
<ul>
<li>遍历数组，每次用回调函数处理当前元素，将结果存入 “累加器”（<code>acc</code>）</li>
<li>回调函数返回值作为下一次的累加器值</li>
<li>最终返回累加器的最终结果</li>
</ul>
<p>用途广泛：求和、数组扁平化、对象分组等。例如数组求和：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript">[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>,<span class="hljs-number">2</span>,<span class="hljs-number">3</span>].<span class="hljs-title function_">reduce</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">acc, curr</span>) =&gt;</span> acc + curr, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 6</span>
</code></pre>
<p><code>initialValue</code>&nbsp;是累加器初始值，省略时以数组第一个元素为初始值。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-97">手写代码实现</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 方法1: 使用递归实现（基础版）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">flattenBasic</span>(<span class="hljs-params">arr</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> result = [];
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; arr.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i++) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 检查当前元素是否为数组</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">isArray</span>(arr[i])) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 递归处理子数组，并将结果合并</span>
      result = result.<span class="hljs-title function_">concat</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">flattenBasic</span>(arr[i]));
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 非数组元素直接添加到结果中</span>
      result.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(arr[i]);
    }
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> result;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 方法2: 带深度控制的递归实现</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">flattenWithDepth</span>(<span class="hljs-params">arr, depth = <span class="hljs-literal">Infinity</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> result = [];
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; arr.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i++) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 当还有深度且当前元素是数组时递归处理</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (depth &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span> &amp;&amp; <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">isArray</span>(arr[i])) {
      result = result.<span class="hljs-title function_">concat</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">flattenWithDepth</span>(arr[i], depth - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>));
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      result.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(arr[i]);
    }
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> result;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 方法3: 使用reduce实现</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">flattenWithReduce</span>(<span class="hljs-params">arr, depth = <span class="hljs-literal">Infinity</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> depth &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span> 
    ? arr.<span class="hljs-title function_">reduce</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">acc, val</span>) =&gt;</span> 
        acc.<span class="hljs-title function_">concat</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">isArray</span>(val) ? <span class="hljs-title function_">flattenWithReduce</span>(val, depth - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) : val), [])
    : arr.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 当depth为0时，返回原数组的拷贝</span>
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> nestedArray = [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, [<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, [<span class="hljs-number">3</span>, [<span class="hljs-number">4</span>, <span class="hljs-number">5</span>], <span class="hljs-number">6</span>], <span class="hljs-number">7</span>], <span class="hljs-number">8</span>, [<span class="hljs-number">9</span>]];
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"原始数组:"</span>, nestedArray);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"基础递归实现:"</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">flattenBasic</span>(nestedArray));
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"带深度控制(2层):"</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">flattenWithDepth</span>(nestedArray, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>));
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"reduce实现:"</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">flattenWithReduce</span>(nestedArray));
</code></pre>
<p>前两种方法比较容易理解，<strong>我们主要来看一下第三种实现(使用reduce实现)</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong><code>reduce</code>&nbsp;的初始值</strong>：<code>[]</code>（空数组），作为累加器&nbsp;<code>acc</code>&nbsp;的起点。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>回调函数的判断逻辑</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>对于当前元素&nbsp;<code>val</code>，先判断是否为数组（<code>Array.isArray(val)</code>）：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>如果是数组</strong>：递归调用&nbsp;<code>flattenWithReduce(val, depth - 1)</code>，同时将深度减 1（控制扁平化层级），把递归返回的结果合并到&nbsp;<code>acc</code>&nbsp;中。</li>
<li><strong>如果不是数组</strong>：直接通过&nbsp;<code>concat</code>&nbsp;把&nbsp;<code>val</code>&nbsp;添加到&nbsp;<code>acc</code>&nbsp;中。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>concat</code>&nbsp;的作用</strong>：无论是合并递归处理后的子数组，还是添加单个元素，都通过&nbsp;<code>concat</code>&nbsp;实现数组拼接，最终累积成一个扁平化的数组。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 data-id="heading-98">十三、实现数组去重</h2>
<p>数组去重仍然有很多的方法可以使用，下面主要讲四个方法，嗯，好像没什么好讲的，都不是很难</p>
<p>方法一二三还是很有必要记住的</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-99">手写实现</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 方法1: 使用Set（最简洁，推荐）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueBySet</span>(<span class="hljs-params">arr</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// Set自动去重，再转换为数组</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> [...<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Set</span>(arr)];
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 方法2: 使用indexOf/includes（兼容性好）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueByIndexOf</span>(<span class="hljs-params">arr</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> result = [];
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; arr.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i++) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 检查元素是否已在结果数组中</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (result.<span class="hljs-title function_">indexOf</span>(arr[i]) === -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>) {
      result.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(arr[i]);
    }
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> result;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 方法3: 使用reduce（函数式风格）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueByReduce</span>(<span class="hljs-params">arr</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> arr.<span class="hljs-title function_">reduce</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">acc, curr</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果累加器中没有当前元素，则添加</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!acc.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(curr)) {
      acc.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(curr);
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> acc;
  }, []); <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始值为空数组</span>
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 方法4: 针对对象数组去重（根据指定属性）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueObjects</span>(<span class="hljs-params">arr, key</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> seen = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Set</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> arr.<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">item</span> =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> value = item[key];
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果未见过该属性值，则保留并记录</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!seen.<span class="hljs-title function_">has</span>(value)) {
      seen.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(value);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
  });
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> primitiveArr = [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'a'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'a'</span>];
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> objectArr = [
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'A'</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'B'</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'A'</span> }
];

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Set去重:"</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueBySet</span>(primitiveArr)); <span class="hljs-comment">// [1,2,3,'a']</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"indexOf去重:"</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueByIndexOf</span>(primitiveArr)); <span class="hljs-comment">// [1,2,3,'a']</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"reduce去重:"</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueByReduce</span>(primitiveArr)); <span class="hljs-comment">// [1,2,3,'a']</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"对象数组去重:"</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueObjects</span>(objectArr, <span class="hljs-string">'id'</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 保留id=1和id=2的对象</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 特殊情况测试</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"包含NaN的去重:"</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueBySet</span>([<span class="hljs-title class_">NaN</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">NaN</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>])); <span class="hljs-comment">// [NaN, 1]（Set能正确处理NaN）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"indexOf处理NaN:"</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">uniqueByIndexOf</span>([<span class="hljs-title class_">NaN</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">NaN</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>])); <span class="hljs-comment">// [NaN, NaN, 1]（indexOf无法识别NaN）</span>
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-100">十四、将数字每千分位用逗号隔开</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-101">手写实现</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 方法1: 使用原生Intl.NumberFormat（推荐）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithIntl</span>(<span class="hljs-params">num</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Intl</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">NumberFormat</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(num);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 方法2: 使用正则表达式</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithRegExp</span>(<span class="hljs-params">num</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理负数</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isNegative = num &lt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> str = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">abs</span>(num).<span class="hljs-title function_">toString</span>();
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 分离整数和小数部分</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> parts = str.<span class="hljs-title function_">split</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> integerPart = parts[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>];
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> decimalPart = parts[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] || <span class="hljs-string">''</span>;
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 正则匹配并插入逗号</span>
  integerPart = integerPart.<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-regexp">/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g</span>, <span class="hljs-string">','</span>);
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 组合结果（包含可能的负数符号和小数部分）</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${isNegative ? <span class="hljs-string">'-'</span> : <span class="hljs-string">''</span>}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${integerPart}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${decimalPart ? <span class="hljs-string">'.'</span> + decimalPart : <span class="hljs-string">''</span>}</span>`</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 方法3: 循环处理（适合理解原理）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithLoop</span>(<span class="hljs-params">num</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isNegative = num &lt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> str = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">abs</span>(num).<span class="hljs-title function_">toString</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">split</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> integerPart = str[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>];
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> decimalPart = str[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] || <span class="hljs-string">''</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> result = [];
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 从后往前每隔三位添加逗号</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = integerPart.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i -= <span class="hljs-number">3</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> start = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, i - <span class="hljs-number">3</span>);
    result.<span class="hljs-title function_">unshift</span>(integerPart.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(start, i));
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 组合结果</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> formattedInteger = result.<span class="hljs-title function_">join</span>(<span class="hljs-string">','</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${isNegative ? <span class="hljs-string">'-'</span> : <span class="hljs-string">''</span>}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${formattedInteger}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${decimalPart ? <span class="hljs-string">'.'</span> + decimalPart : <span class="hljs-string">''</span>}</span>`</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithIntl</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1234567</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// "1,234,567"</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithIntl</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1234567.89</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// "1,234,567.89"</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithIntl</span>(-<span class="hljs-number">12345</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// "-12,345"</span>

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithRegExp</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1234567</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// "1,234,567"</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithRegExp</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1234567.89</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// "1,234,567.89"</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithRegExp</span>(-<span class="hljs-number">12345</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// "-12,345"</span>

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithLoop</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1234567</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// "1,234,567"</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithLoop</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1234567.89</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// "1,234,567.89"</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">formatWithLoop</span>(-<span class="hljs-number">12345</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// "-12,345"</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>下面我对这些方法进行一些讲解</strong></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-102">方法一</h4>
<p><code>formatWithIntl</code>&nbsp;函数利用 JavaScript 内置的&nbsp;<code>Intl.NumberFormat</code>&nbsp;API 实现数字的千分位格式化</p>
<p><code>Intl.NumberFormat</code>&nbsp;是浏览器处理数字国际化格式化的原生对象，<strong>默认会根据环境添加千分位分隔符</strong></p>
<p>调用&nbsp;<code>format(num)</code>&nbsp;方法会返回格式化后的字符串，会自动处理：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>整数部分每三位加逗号</strong>（如&nbsp;<code>1234567</code>&nbsp;→&nbsp;<code>"1,234,567"</code>）</li>
<li><strong>保留小数部分</strong>（如&nbsp;<code>1234.56</code>&nbsp;→&nbsp;<code>"1,234.56"</code>）</li>
<li><strong>正确处理负数</strong>（如&nbsp;<code>-1234</code>&nbsp;→&nbsp;<code>"-1,234"</code>）</li>
</ul>
<p>优点：代码极简，无需手动处理复杂逻辑，还支持多语言格式化（通过参数配置），适合现代环境使用。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-103">方法二</h4>
<p>方法二主要是下面的地方需要理解</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript">integerPart = integerPart.<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-regexp">/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g</span>, <span class="hljs-string">','</span>);
<span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${isNegative ? <span class="hljs-string">'-'</span> : <span class="hljs-string">''</span>}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${integerPart}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${decimalPart ? <span class="hljs-string">'.'</span> + decimalPart : <span class="hljs-string">''</span>}</span>`</span>;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>正则 integerPart = integerPart.replace (/\B (?=(\d {3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');</strong></p>
<p>这行用正则表达式给整数部分添加千分位逗号，核心是正则&nbsp;<code>/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g</code>：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>\B</code>：匹配非单词边界（避免在数字开头加逗号）</li>
<li><code>(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))</code>：正向预查，确保当前位置后有<strong>3 的倍数个数字</strong>（且之后没有其他数字）</li>
<li>整体效果：从右往左，每隔 3 位数字加一个逗号（如&nbsp;<code>"1234567"</code>&nbsp;→&nbsp;<code>"1,234,567"</code>）</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>return&nbsp;<code>${isNegative ? '-' : ''}${integerPart}${decimalPart ? '.' + decimalPart : ''}</code>;</strong></p>
<p>这行拼接最终结果，处理三种情况：</p>
<ol>
<li>负数符号：如果原数是负数（<code>isNegative</code>&nbsp;为&nbsp;<code>true</code>），开头加&nbsp;<code>-</code></li>
<li>整数部分：拼接处理好千分位的&nbsp;<code>integerPart</code></li>
<li>小数部分：如果有小数（<code>decimalPart</code>&nbsp;存在），加&nbsp;<code>.</code>&nbsp;和小数部分</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>当然，如果正则记不住的话也没关系，我也记不住，相信面试官会理解的</strong></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-104">十五、实现非负大整数相加</h2>
<p>我们当然可以使用BigInt实现非负大整数相加，但是我觉得面试官并不是问这个的，下面是<strong>使用字符串模拟非负大数相加的方法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">addBigIntegers</span>(<span class="hljs-params">a, b</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化指针（从末尾开始）和进位</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = a.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> j = b.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> carry = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> result = [];
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 遍历两个数字字符串，处理每一位相加</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">while</span> (i &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">0</span> || j &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">0</span> || carry &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 获取当前位的数字（超出长度则视为0）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> digitA = i &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">0</span> ? <span class="hljs-built_in">parseInt</span>(a[i], <span class="hljs-number">10</span>) : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> digitB = j &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">0</span> ? <span class="hljs-built_in">parseInt</span>(b[j], <span class="hljs-number">10</span>) : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 计算当前位总和（包含进位）</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sum = digitA + digitB + carry;
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 取当前位结果（sum % 10）</span>
    result.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(sum % <span class="hljs-number">10</span>);
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 更新进位（Math.floor(sum / 10)）</span>
    carry = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(sum / <span class="hljs-number">10</span>);
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 移动指针</span>
    i--;
    j--;
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 结果数组反转后拼接成字符串</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> result.<span class="hljs-title function_">reverse</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">join</span>(<span class="hljs-string">''</span>);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试用例</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">addBigIntegers</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'12345678901234567890'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'98765432109876543210'</span>)); 
<span class="hljs-comment">// 输出: "111111111011111111100"</span>

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">addBigIntegers</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'999'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'999'</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 输出: "1998"</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">addBigIntegers</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'0'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'0'</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 输出: "0"</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">addBigIntegers</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'123'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'456789'</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 输出: "456912"</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>下面介绍一下这个题的核心逻辑</strong></p>
<p>两个大数，从末尾到高位开始加，末尾相加会是一个数字，它的范围是[18,0]，然后我们去各位，十位当进位(就是十进一)，该进位参与到下一次的倒数第二位的相加</p>
<p>如果一个数字的位数少，那么之后的相加，就假设这个数字在高位上的位数为0</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-105">十六、实现 add(1)(2)(3)</h2>
<p>这个地方考察的就是函数柯里化，那么什么是柯里化？</p>
<p><strong>函数柯里化</strong> 是一种函数转换技术，将接收多个参数的函数，转换为一系列只接收部分参数的函数，这些函数依次调用，最终完成原函数的功能。</p>
<p><strong>下面举个例子</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 普通函数</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-params">a, b, c</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> a + b + c;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 柯里化后</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">curriedAdd</span>(<span class="hljs-params">a</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>(<span class="hljs-params">b</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>(<span class="hljs-params">c</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> a + b + c;
    }
  }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 调用方式</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">curriedAdd</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>)(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>)(<span class="hljs-number">3</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 6</span>
</code></pre>
<p>这种就叫做柯里化，但是<strong>这种写法太过粗暴，不够优雅</strong>，下面的写法才是优雅的写法</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">curry</span>(<span class="hljs-params">fn</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 记录原函数的参数长度（形参数量）</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> requiredArgs = fn.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>;

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 递归收集参数的内部函数</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">curried</span>(<span class="hljs-params">...args</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 情况1：已收集的参数足够，执行原函数</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (args.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> &gt;= requiredArgs) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> fn.<span class="hljs-title function_">apply</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>, args); <span class="hljs-comment">// 保持this上下文</span>
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 情况2：参数不足，返回新函数继续收集</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> (<span class="hljs-params">...nextArgs</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 合并已有参数和新参数，递归调用</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> curried.<span class="hljs-title function_">apply</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>, [...args, ...nextArgs]);
    };
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> curried;
}
<span class="hljs-comment">// 原函数：求三个数的和</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-params">a, b, c</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> a + b + c;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 柯里化处理</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> curriedAdd = <span class="hljs-title function_">curry</span>(add);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 多种调用方式均生效</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">curriedAdd</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>)(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>)(<span class="hljs-number">3</span>));    <span class="hljs-comment">// 6（分步传参）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">curriedAdd</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>)(<span class="hljs-number">3</span>));   <span class="hljs-comment">// 6（先传2个，再传1个）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">curriedAdd</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>)(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>));   <span class="hljs-comment">// 6（先传1个，再传2个）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">curriedAdd</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>));   <span class="hljs-comment">// 6（一次性传完）</span>
</code></pre>
<p>这种代码看似比较混乱，但是我们深入探究，会发现一个我们的老朋友——<strong>闭包</strong></p>
<p>还记得当时我防抖节流是为何可以记住，上次的定时器是否为空的吗？没错，就是<strong>闭包</strong>。</p>
<p>相似的，那么我们这次为什么下一次传参可以记住上次的传参内容，从而完成多次传参呢？还是<strong>闭包</strong></p>
<p>让我们把视线移到<strong>闭包</strong>身上——</p>
<p>当参数不足时，<code>curried</code>&nbsp;会返回一个新的匿名函数，这个匿名函数引用了：</p>
<ul>
<li>上层&nbsp;<code>curried</code>&nbsp;函数的&nbsp;<code>args</code>（已收集的参数）</li>
<li>上层的&nbsp;<code>curried</code>&nbsp;函数本身<br>
这使得每次调用时，都能累积参数并继续递归，而这些参数状态不会因函数执行完毕而丢失。</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>从而完成了可以多次传参的柯里化实现</strong></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-106">十七、使用ES5和ES6求函数参数的和</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-107">预备知识</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-108">arguments 对象</h4>
<p><code>arguments</code>&nbsp;是 JavaScript 中函数内部的一个<strong>类数组对象（array-like object）</strong> ，用于<strong>存储函数被调用时传入的所有实际参数</strong>。<strong>它在 ES5 及更早版本中是处理不定参数的主要方式</strong></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-109">...args</h4>
<p><code>...args</code>&nbsp;是 JavaScript ES6 引入的<strong>剩余参数（Rest Parameters）</strong> &nbsp;语法，用于在函数定义中收集多个传入的参数，将其合并为一个<strong>真正的数组</strong>。它解决了 ES5 中&nbsp;<code>arguments</code>&nbsp;类数组对象的局限性，是处理不定参数的<strong>现代方案</strong>。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-110">手写实现</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// ES5 实现（使用arguments对象）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sumES5</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">var</span> total = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-comment">// arguments是类数组对象，包含所有传入的参数</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">var</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; <span class="hljs-variable language_">arguments</span>.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i++) {
    total += <span class="hljs-variable language_">arguments</span>[i];
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> total;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// ES6 实现（使用剩余参数 ...）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sumES6</span>(<span class="hljs-params">...args</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// args是真正的数组，包含所有传入的参数</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> args.<span class="hljs-title function_">reduce</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>(<span class="hljs-params">acc, curr</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> acc + curr;
  }, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 更简洁的ES6箭头函数版本</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sumES6Arrow</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">...args</span>) =&gt; args.<span class="hljs-title function_">reduce</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">acc, curr</span>) =&gt;</span> acc + curr, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 测试</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">sumES5</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">4</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 10</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">sumES6</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">4</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 10</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">sumES6Arrow</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number">4</span>, <span class="hljs-number">5</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 15</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">sumES5</span>(<span class="hljs-number">10</span>, <span class="hljs-number">20</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 30</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">sumES6</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>)); <span class="hljs-comment">// 0</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>对于具体的ES5与ES6的代码实现其实并不困难，关键是理解arguments对象与...args</strong></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-111">十八、解析URLParams为对象</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-112"><strong>什么是URLParams?</strong></h3>
<p><code>URLParams</code>（通常称为 URL 参数或查询参数）是 URL 中用于传递额外信息的键值对集合，<strong>位于 URL 的&nbsp;<code>?</code>&nbsp;之后，格式为&nbsp;<code>key=value</code>，多个参数之间用&nbsp;<code>&amp;</code>&nbsp;分隔。</strong></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-113">基本概念</h4>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>位置</strong>：URL 中&nbsp;<code>?</code>&nbsp;后面的部分，例如在&nbsp;<code>https://example.com/search?query=js&amp;page=1</code>&nbsp;中，<code>query=js&amp;page=1</code>&nbsp;就是 URL 参数。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>作用</strong>：向服务器或前端页面传递数据（如查询条件、分页信息、用户标识等），是 HTTP 协议中客户端与服务器交互的常用方式。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-114"><strong>格式</strong>：</h4>
<ul>
<li>
<p>单个参数：<code>key=value</code>（如&nbsp;<code>id=123</code>）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>多个参数：用&nbsp;<code>&amp;</code>&nbsp;连接（如&nbsp;<code>name=张三&amp;age=20</code>）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>特殊情况：</p>
<ul>
<li>无值参数：仅包含键（如&nbsp;<code>active</code>，等价于&nbsp;<code>active=</code>）</li>
<li>同名参数：允许重复键（如&nbsp;<code>hobby=篮球&amp;hobby=音乐</code>）</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-115">特殊字符处理</h4>
<p>URL 参数中不能直接包含空格、中文、<code>&amp;</code>、<code>=</code>&nbsp;等特殊字符，需通过&nbsp;<strong>URL 编码</strong>&nbsp;转换为安全格式：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>编码：使用&nbsp;<code>encodeURIComponent()</code>&nbsp;处理（如空格 →&nbsp;<code>%20</code>，中文 “张三” →&nbsp;<code>%E5%BC%A0%E4%B8%89</code>）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>解码：使用&nbsp;<code>decodeURIComponent()</code>&nbsp;还原（如&nbsp;<code>%20</code>&nbsp;→ 空格）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>例如，<code>name=张 三</code>&nbsp;编码后为&nbsp;<code>name=张%20三</code>。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-116">手写实现</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini">function parseParamsManually(url) {
  // 提取查询字符串（去掉开头的?）
  const <span class="hljs-attr">queryString</span> = (url || window.location.search).split(<span class="hljs-string">'?'</span>)[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] || <span class="hljs-string">''</span><span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  if (!queryString) return {}<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  
  const <span class="hljs-attr">result</span> = {}<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  // 按&amp;分割参数
  const <span class="hljs-attr">paramPairs</span> = queryString.split(<span class="hljs-string">'&amp;'</span>)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  
  paramPairs.forEach(<span class="hljs-attr">pair</span> =&gt; {
    // 处理没有=的参数（如 ?token）
    const <span class="hljs-section">[key, value = '']</span> = pair.split('=')<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    // 解码特殊字符（如%20解码为空格）
    const <span class="hljs-attr">decodedKey</span> = decodeURIComponent(key)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    const <span class="hljs-attr">decodedValue</span> = decodeURIComponent(value)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    
    // 处理同名参数
    if (result.hasOwnProperty(decodedKey)) {
      result<span class="hljs-section">[decodedKey]</span> = Array.isArray(result<span class="hljs-section">[decodedKey]</span>)
        ? <span class="hljs-section">[...result[decodedKey]</span>, decodedValue]
        : <span class="hljs-section">[result[decodedKey]</span>, decodedValue]<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    } else {
      result<span class="hljs-section">[decodedKey]</span> = decodedValue<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    }
  })<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  
  return result<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
}

// 测试
const <span class="hljs-attr">testUrl</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'https://example.com?name=张三&amp;age=25&amp;hobby=篮球&amp;hobby=音乐&amp;active'</span><span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
console.log(parseParamsUsingAPI(testUrl))<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
console.log(parseParamsManually(testUrl))<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
// 输出: 
// {
//   name: "张三",
//   age: "25",
//   hobby: <span class="hljs-section">["篮球", "音乐"]</span>,
//   active: ""
// }

</code></pre>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/431fff5084494501a4bdc195322e5f4f~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aSp5aSp5omt56CB:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761713842&amp;x-signature=i%2Brx8v5uX3m3zIuToa6ggS5T7w8%3D" alt="image.png" width="70%" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>这个手写题的核心是理解URLParams的构成，构成在前文有提及</strong></p>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/3c9ea60f97564f94b1bcf79c32f024f3~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aSp5aSp5omt56CB:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761713842&amp;x-signature=vD03GrHVWXw5ygjRIi1Hz%2FDvZoU%3D" alt="屏幕截图 2025-08-06 204737.png" width="50%" loading="lazy"></p>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/1a09955177c9474591a6e2dffb54d134~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aSp5aSp5omt56CB:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761713842&amp;x-signature=Uh1Y1UPuVR%2BtaStSmrMf6GBO1JE%3D" alt="屏幕截图 2025-08-06 204750.png" width="50%" loading="lazy"></p>

<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e9384b63e0494d1698562558795834b1~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aSp5aSp5omt56CB:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761713842&amp;x-signature=9oEJjAr4xddj77o7BNWcxmyRA4E%3D" alt="屏幕截图 2025-08-06 204829.png" width="50%" loading="lazy"></p>
<p align="center"><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e6821a951d2444d7abb2dd42315c13de~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aSp5aSp5omt56CB:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761713842&amp;x-signature=IfRJRoua7pj%2FeCaVk2P2I%2BvD7Ig%3D" alt="屏幕截图 2025-08-06 204850.png" width="50%" loading="lazy"></p>

<p><strong>当然还有的实现方式是使用原生API或者正则实现，但是我不推荐，因为记不住</strong></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-117">十九、循环打印红黄绿</h2>
<p>这一题，我们要巧妙的使用定时器，如果我们要循环打印，则可以使用递归来完成，代码比较简单</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-118">手写实现</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">function <span class="hljs-built_in">startTrafficLights</span>() {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 定义灯的配置：颜色和对应亮灯时长（毫秒）</span>
  const lights = <span class="hljs-selector-attr">[    { color: <span class="hljs-string">'红'</span>, duration: 3000 },    { color: <span class="hljs-string">'绿'</span>, duration: 1000 },    { color: <span class="hljs-string">'黄'</span>, duration: 2000 }  ]</span>;
  
  let currentIndex = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 当前亮灯的索引</span>
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 定义亮灯函数</span>
  function <span class="hljs-built_in">turnOnLight</span>() {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 获取当前灯的配置</span>
    const { <span class="hljs-attribute">color</span>, duration } = lights<span class="hljs-selector-attr">[currentIndex]</span>;
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 打印当前亮灯信息</span>
    console<span class="hljs-selector-class">.log</span>(`现在是${color}灯亮，持续${duration/<span class="hljs-number">1000</span>}秒`);
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 计算下一个灯的索引（循环切换）</span>
    currentIndex = (currentIndex + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) % lights<span class="hljs-selector-class">.length</span>;
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 经过duration时间后，切换到下一个灯</span>
    <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(turnOnLight, duration);
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 启动第一个灯</span>
  <span class="hljs-built_in">turnOnLight</span>();
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 启动交通信号灯</span>
<span class="hljs-built_in">startTrafficLights</span>();
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-119">结语</h2>
<p><strong>前端手写题上也是到这里就结束了，相信过几天就可以把手写题下发出来了</strong></p>
